description: This file defines helper functions used for lookup and reference operations within the PhpSpreadsheet library, including cell address conversion, extraction, and worksheet handling.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for cell address conversion, sheet name adjustment, cell address extraction, and worksheet extraction within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: convertR1C1
methods.description: Converts R1C1-style references to A1 style if necessary and concatenates cell references.

methods.name: adjustSheetTitle
methods.description: Appends sheet title information to cell references and clears the title if it matches the cell address.

methods.name: extractCellAddresses
methods.description: Extracts cell addresses from a string, resolving named ranges and converting to the correct reference style, returning parts and combined address.

methods.name: extractWorksheet
methods.description: Extracts worksheet name from a cell address string and retrieves the corresponding worksheet object.
